title: Stuhr Museum of the Prairie Pioneer

services.name: Current Exhibits
services.desc: Stuhr Museum is proud to announce A LIFE IN THE WILD, a nationally touring exhibition featuring the work of acclaimed wildlife photographer Thomas D. Mangelsen, will be exhibited in the Leo B. Stuhr Building this summer. On view June 20 through September 7, 2026, this landmark exhibition marks the final stop of an extraordinary 8-year, 31-venue tour spanning the United States and Canada-and carries special significance as a homecoming to Mangelsen’s Nebraska roots. Featuring 40 of Mangelsen’s most resonant and iconic wildlife images, A LIFE IN THE WILD invites visitors on a powerful visual journey into the natural world and the fragile balance of survival shared by its most iconic species.

services.name: Virtual Field Trips
services.desc: Step back in time and explore the sights and sounds of Railroad Town, bustling with costumed historical interpreters, hands-on activities, and more from May through mid-September each year. Visit the iconic Leo B. Stuhr Building and the Fonner Rotunda, where engaging exhibits await. Self-guided field trips offer the freedom to create your own schedule, allowing you to interact with exhibits and activities at your own pace. While these visits don’t include structured instruction, they’re perfect for exploring at your leisure. Enjoy a picnic in our outdoor areas, available on a first-come, first-served basis.
